summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.38/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.38 a gallon across Wisconsin as of September 20, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 34¢ higher than a week ago, 51¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.53 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($4.24) and the highest in Merrill ($4.55).
